parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This part consists of one blade and its attached handle, made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism and provides a grip for the user to apply force during cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the screw pivot to open and close against the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This part includes the second blade and its handle, made of stainless steel and plastic respectively.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the complementary half of the cutting mechanism, working with the other blade to shear materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw to move in opposition to the other blade handle set, enabling cutting action.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at the pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two blade handle sets together and allows them to rotate smoothly around the pivot.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around it.
